claims.gist: By 2025, 70% of organizations will shift to small and wide data
Pandemic disruption made historical data obsolete, breaking AI models
Decision-making is overly reliant on data-hungry deep learning
D&A leaders need small and wide data techniques
Small and wide data use available data more effectively
Small data requires less data yet yields useful insights
Wide data enables analysis across diverse data formats
Both approaches enable more robust analytics and reduce big data dependence
Leaders apply both to address scarce training data
Potential uses include retail forecasting and customer service
Other potential uses include fraud detection and autonomous robots

thesis: By 2025, 70% of organizations will shift from big data to small and wide data for more robust AI.
